title: SMB
description: SMB file sharing: negotiate request, tells SMB1 from SMB2/3 (port 445)

match.long: SMB 2.x or 3.x (the server answered with an SMB2 negotiate response)
SMB1 (legacy, insecure: the server answered with an SMB1 negotiate response)

fallback.long: Port open, but no SMB negotiate response
